title: Universal one-step graphitization of silicon-enriched biomass-derived carbon in molten salts for lithium-ion battery anodes
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,3293-3303
DOI: 10.1039/D4SE01602E, Paper
Fan Wang, Yuxin Wang, Ziheng Guan, Junjie Wei, Shengliang He, Zhen Zhong, Hao Chen, Peizhong Feng
Low-cost graphite anodes from agricultural waste via one-step graphitization in K2CO3–Na2CO3 molten salt remove SiO2, achieving a higher Li-ion capacity than commercial graphite (293 vs. 287.8 mA h g−1).
